## WakePoint Simulation Audit — GPS-Denied Transit Tracking Test Harness (10 Jul 2026)

### Verdict: UNRELIABLE (not BROKEN)
A real EKF path exists and works — but only on one route. The default dashboard scenarios silently bypass the filter, a faked stack is still in the tree, synthetic IMU is non-physical, and there are **zero** objective metrics or a regression harness. This precisely explains "unreliable and useless."

---

### 1. The core defect: the dashboard tests nothing on its default routes

`unified_dashboard.dart:1613` mounts **`EkfTestPanel`** (good), which drives `EkfTestController` → real `EkfOrchestrator`. But:

- `ekf_test_panel.dart:152-159` only calls `loadUnifiedLog()` (which initializes the EKF) for the **Log-Replay** route. Purple/Green/Non-Metro call `loadRoute()`.
- `EkfTestController.loadRoute()` (`ekf_test_controller.dart:367-373`) and `initialize()` (`324-364`) **never call `_initializeEkf()` or `_subscribeToEngineImu()`**.
- Every EKF branch in `_onTick` is gated `if (_ekfOrchestrator != null)` (`653, 677, 869`). With a null orchestrator: no IMU is fed, `ekfPosition/ekfProgress/sigma` are null, ZUPT and station-snap never fire.

**So the GPS-dropout toggle on the metro routes exercises no dead reckoning at all.** Fix = call `_initializeEkf()`+`_subscribeToEngineImu()` in `loadRoute()`/`initialize()`. This is the single highest-leverage change.

### 2. Orphaned faked stack still shipping
`ekf_replay_panel.dart:159-166` fabricates EKF output (`ekfProgress = elapsed/duration*totalMeters`, `ekfSigma=50`, `zupt=false`, `ekfPosition=gps`); its engine `imu_replay_engine.dart:563-657` synthesizes GPS at constant 11 m/s, bearing 90°, accel `z=9.81` const, gyro≈0. `grep` proves **`EkfReplayPanel` is referenced nowhere**. Delete v1 (`ekf_replay_panel.dart` + `imu_replay_engine.dart`) — patching it is wasted effort.

### 3. Synthetic IMU is not integrable
`imu_replay_engine_v2.dart:2049-2108`: forward accel is a constant 0.5 / -0.8 m/s² by motion-state, decoupled from the true speed derivative (`accelRate=1.2`, `brakeRate=2.0` at `1900-1933`); gyro is pure noise (`// TODO: Calculate actual angular velocity`); gravity fixed to Z. Integrating this cannot recover the route's velocity — synthetic-route dead reckoning is meaningless. **Real CSV/unified-log replay is the only trustworthy IMU source today** (`_tickLogReplay` at `2227+`, `loadFromLog` `987-1092`, `loadUnifiedRouteLog` `881-985`).

### 4. No metrics, no pass/fail, no consistency check
`grep` for `NEES|pass.fail|leadError|falseAlarm|assert.*bound` finds nothing in the sim. Error only appears in a debug log string (`ekf_test_controller.dart:704-722`). `groundTruthPolyline` exists for drawing only. There is no blackout-end error, alarm-lead error, false-alarm rate, or covariance consistency.

### 5. No regression harness
Sim is GUI-only (`flutter run -t lib/main_unified_dashboard.dart`, `ekf_test_panel.dart:190-215`). No headless multi-scenario runner, nothing asserts bounds, nothing in CI.

### 6. Coverage & fault-injection gaps
`GpsDropoutMode` (`imu_replay_engine_v2.dart:62-80`) = complete/tunnel/intermittent/accuracyDegraded/urbanCanyon. **Missing:** wrong-direction, express skip-stop, transfers, station-dwell-vs-through, cold-start-underground, multi-blackout, mid-run sensor loss, process-kill/restore. `EkfOrchestrator.setNoGyro` (`ekf_orchestrator.dart:284`) exists but no UI exposes it.

### 7. Two engines
v1 `ImuReplayEngine` (660 LOC) and v2 `ImuReplayEngineV2` (2692 LOC) with duplicate types (`ReplayTickResult` vs `...V2`) — maintenance drag and the source of the "inconsistent" complaint.

---

## What a SOTA GPS-denied transit test harness needs (2026)

Autonomy/robotics practice has converged on **scenario-based testing + fault injection + ground-truth replay + consistency metrics**, all run headless in regression:

- **Scenario-based testing** with interpretable failure modes and **metamorphic/relational oracles** where absolute ground truth is unavailable — the dominant AV validation paradigm ([Springer, Simulation Testing of ADS via Safety-Critical Scenario Generation, 2025](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-981-95-8617-2_2); [IEEE ADWG Simulation/Testing/Validation white paper](https://sagroups.ieee.org/adwg/wp-content/uploads/sites/661/2024/10/ADWG_STV2_whitepaper.pdf); [TÜV SÜD scenario-based testing](https://www.tuvsud.com/en-us/industries/mobility-and-automotive/automotive-and-oem/autonomous-driving/assessment-of-automated-vehicles-with-scenario-based-testing)).
- **Simulation-based sensor-fault injection** — deliberately drop/degrade sensors on a controlled timeline and measure downstream behavior ([MDPI Informatics, Simulating Sensor Failures on AVs, 2025](https://www.mdpi.com/2227-9709/12/3/94)).
- **GPS/GNSS-denied localization harnesses** validated in sim *and* on logged real drives, reporting velocity-dependent pose-error distributions ([LiDAR-based GNSS-denied localization, Roborace](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7411595/)).
- **Automated scenario generation + reporting** run as a batch that emits per-scenario pass/fail reports ([Fast & Realistic Automated Scenario Simulations, arXiv 2512.24402](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2512.24402)).
- **Filter-consistency metrics: NEES / ANEES / NIS** with chi-square bounds — the standard objective test that an estimator's covariance is honest (NEES→state-dim, position≈2; NIS on innovations) ([NEES](https://kalman-filter.com/normalized-estimation-error-squared/); [NIS](https://kalman-filter.com/normalized-innovation-squared/); [T-ESKF consistent VIO, arXiv 2510.23359](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.23359); [nyx-space #128: NEES/NIS for KF tuning](https://github.com/nyx-space/nyx/issues/128)).

---

## Scenario library WakePoint must have (as data-driven `ScenarioSpec`s)

Each spec = {base ride or CSV log, blackout intervals, direction, skip-stops, transfers, dwell overrides, sensor-fault schedule, device pose, expected bounds}. Minimum set:

1. **Baseline** metro ride, GPS good (sanity + false-alarm=0).
2. **Single tunnel**, length swept 200 m → 4 km (blackout-end error vs distance).
3. **Multi-blackout** (several tunnels + surface gaps in one ride).
4. **Cold-start underground** (first GPS fix arrives mid-tunnel / after 1st stop).
5. **Wrong-direction** (rider boards opposite platform).
6. **Express / skip-stop** (train skips the alarm stop's neighbors).
7. **Transfer / interchange** (line change, dwell + walk leg).
8. **Station dwell vs through** (does it distinguish stop-here from pass-through).
9. **Urban-canyon multipath** (heavy-tailed GPS jitter; exercises the Huber path at `ekf_pipeline.dart:261-286`).
10. **Cheap-sensor noise** (high accel/gyro variance + bias).
11. **No-gyro device** (wire `setNoGyro`).
12. **Fault injection:** GPS drop@t/return@t, mid-run accel/gyro loss, **process-kill/restore** (serialize→reload EKF state; cold-start recovery).

---

## Components, prioritized by test value

| # | Component | Why | Effort |
|---|-----------|-----|--------|
| **P0** | Fix `loadRoute()`/`initialize()` to init+feed the real EKF | Without it the sim tests nothing on default routes | Tiny (2 calls) |
| **P0** | Ground-truth **metrics module** (along-route error, blackout-end error, alarm-lead error, false-alarm, **NEES/NIS** bands) | Turns "eyeball" into objective pass/fail; defines "reliable" | Medium |
| **P0** | **Headless scenario runner** (Dart test/CLI over ScenarioSpec, asserts bounds) | The regression harness; enables CI | Medium |
| **P1** | Delete v1 faked stack; unify on v2 | Removes the wrong-file trap and UI inconsistency | Small |
| **P1** | **Fault injection** (GPS drop/return, sensor loss, no-gyro, process-kill/restore) | Covers the failures that actually mis-fire alarms | Medium |
| **P1** | Physically-consistent synthetic IMU (accel = true speed derivative; gyro from bearing rate; pose-rotated gravity) OR log-replay-only for EKF validation | Makes synthetic scenarios valid for dead reckoning | Medium |
| **P2** | **Unified overlay** (true/GPS/EKF tracks + σ band + blackout shading + station snaps + alarm-fire marker w/ lead-error), driven by metrics module | Visual consistency; numbers match the picture | Medium |
| **P2** | ScenarioSpec-as-data (YAML/JSON) + synthetic scenario generator | Author any real-world case without code | Medium |

**Bottom line:** the EKF and a real log-replay path already exist and work — the harness is failing on integration (wrong loader path skips EKF init), hygiene (faked v1 still present, non-physical synthetic IMU), and rigor (no metrics, no headless regression, thin fault injection). Fixing the two P0 wiring/metrics items alone converts the dashboard from "useless" to genuinely testing the GPS-denied wake path.

## WakePoint In-App Simulator — Synthesized Teardown & Rebuild Plan

**Verdict: UNRELIABLE (BROKEN for the stated mission).** A real `EkfOrchestrator` genuinely runs in exactly one code path (the 49MB unified log), so the sim is not entirely fake. But it is wired so narrowly, and surrounded by so much dead / fabricated / disconnected code, that it cannot validate the product's core claim — *wake the rider before their stop, GPS-denied* — and cannot exercise the scenarios the founder needs. Three independent audits converged on this; I verified the load-bearing facts against the code.

### Verified ground truth
- `assets/ekf_test_routes/bengaluru_metro_routes.json` **does not exist** and is not in `pubspec.yaml` → all three metro routes throw at load (`imu_replay_engine.dart:312`, `imu_replay_engine_v2.dart:1095/1172/1209`).
- `_initializeEkf()`/`_subscribeToEngineImu()` fire **only** at `ekf_test_controller.dart:384/387, 413/416, 440/443` (the three log loaders) — **never** in `initialize()`(324) or `loadRoute()`(367). Confirmed the null-EKF guard on every `_onTick` branch.

2. **Real EKF only wired in the log path** — all 8 scenarios + curated routes run a null EKF, so flagship GPS-dropout/tunnel dead-reckoning never executes.
